name: Apollo 16 S-IVB Booster Impact: 0.5 km impact-site boundary
rationale: NASA 2011 §A1-3: impact sites have a descent/landing boundary 'extending to a 0.5 km radial distance from the center of the impact site'. The 2011 document names Ranger and S-IVB impact sites. Coordinates: LROC anthropogenic shapefile (Averaged NACs, ±11.2 m). The NASA 2011 recommendations cover U.S. Government artifacts only. The One Small Step Act (Pub. L. 116-275) makes them a condition of NASA contracts; neither it nor the Artemis Accords sets distances.

sources.label: NASA (2011, Rev A 28 Oct 2011), Recommendations to Space-Faring Entities: How to Protect and Preserve the Historic and Scientific Value of U.S. Government Lunar Artifacts
